headline: Report: $250K fines for Sirianni, Vrabel, Glenn temporarily on hold
summary: Nick Sirianni was fined $250,000 for conduct toward officials, a source said, confirming an SI report that noted Mike Vrabel and Aaron Glenn were similarly fined.

headline: Former Chiefs, Falcons DL Allen Bailey Dies At 37
summary: Former Chiefs and Falcons defensive lineman Allen Bailey passed away this week at the age of 37. His family’s initial belief is that he died of natural causes, though an official cause of death has not been released. “Allen Bailey was an excellent teammate, generous man, and kind soul,” the Chiefs said in a statement. headline: After two years rehabbing, Tank Dell overwhelmed, anxious and excited to play again
summary: Texans wide receiver Tank Dell has not played a game since Dec. 21, 2024, when he tore multiple ligaments and dislocated his kneecap in a game against the Chiefs.

headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs says he is trying to learn from 'mistake,' move forward
summary: Josh Jacobs, in his first comments since his arrest in May following an incident with a woman at his home, said he is trying to move forward from the "mistake."
